label_policy: Original labels and candidate text/IDs preserved without correction; unresolved products excluded as whole records.
quarantine_rules_basis: Supplied-text label audit, not prediction correctness; no model outputs are read to generate these files.

split.algorithm: Within each stratum sort original product keys by (SHA256(UTF8(seed + newline + key)), key); select the first round(n * 0.2), bounded to [1, n-1], for validation; preserve original input order within output files.

limitations: Not independently adjudicated by Vertex; remaining labels are provisional rather than guaranteed correct.
The original 50 products were already inspected and used to refine the matching policy; validation is not a previously unseen holdout.
Exclusions were informed by prior error review, so this subset has selection bias; do not compare its scores directly with the original benchmark.
Validation has only six products; retain an external unseen test set for final generalization claims.
No fine-tuning chat-message JSONL is produced; these files use the original product-matching input/label schema.
